prompt.project_info: Create a casual morning bedroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman resting in bed.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with soft dark-brown medium-length slightly messy hair, almond dark-brown eyes, fair clear skin, minimal makeup and calm gaze, wearing a grey ribbed scoop-neck short-sleeve top with secure coverage and grey-white patterned lounge shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Reclined on back or side against pillows, right arm raised holding smartphone, left arm resting on bed, legs bent and partially covered, beige linen bedding, window with white trim, white mirror frame and neutral wall.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight from the left, gentle hair highlights, cozy relaxed candid atmosphere, natural linen and skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mirror selfie, smartphone reflection, casual candid framing, sharp subject and phone, realistic colors and natural depth.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A casual photorealistic morning mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with soft dark-brown medium-length slightly messy hair, almond dark-brown eyes, fair clear skin, minimal makeup, and a calm gaze. She reclines comfortably on her back or side against pillows, holding a smartphone in her raised right hand while her left arm rests on the bed. She wears a grey ribbed short-sleeve top with secure coverage and grey-white patterned lounge shorts, with legs bent and partially covered. The bedroom has beige linen bedding, a window with white trim, a white mirror frame, and a neutral wall. Use soft natural daylight from the left, gentle hair highlights, sharp phone reflection, realistic linen and skin texture, and cozy candid color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, low-cut top, visible cleavage, exposed underwear, sexualized lying pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, bedroom, bedding, mirror, window, phone, and morning light; replace wardrobe with equally opaque loungewear. Keep pose comfortable and typography absent.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced cleavage/exposed-underwear wording with secure short-sleeve coverage and partially covered lounge shorts.
